newsitem.title: JAPAN: Orders for chip-making devices fall in Dec--report.
newsitem.headline: Orders for chip-making devices fall in Dec--report.

text.p: Orders received by Japanese makers for semiconductor-producing equipment fell 35.2 percent year on year in December, dropping for the sixth consecutive month, a Japanese wire service said.

The Semiconductor Equipment Association of Japan said on Sunday that Japanese equipment makers had received 46.47 billion yen worth of orders for chip-making equipment in December due to the semiconductor industry"s efforts to cut their capital spending, Nikkei Telcom, a unit of Nihon Keizai Shimbun, reported on Sunday.
